relevance: Relevant = substantive economic conditions, household finances or economic policy; grade inflation/company-name accidents are Keyword false positive; stock picks without economic conditions are Investment-only.
geography: US economic subject; US-linked international when foreign events explicitly affect US conditions; outlet location and author nationality alone are insufficient.
genre: Classify observable presentation. Corporate promotion may be Promotional; reporting on a company is not inherently promotion.
economic_tone: Direction of economic conditions described, including meaningful expectations; Mixed requires both favorable and unfavorable conditions. Negative facts are not emotion.
emotional_wording: Emotive/evaluative wording in author voice or headline; record attributed headline wording with its voice. No automatic emotion from negative facts.
emotional_quote: Emotional wording in attributed quotation, distinguished from author narration. Posts use the post author as author voice.
primary_topic: Foregrounded substantive topic; Multiple requires equally prominent topics.
price_frame: Levels = expense or cumulative changes; rate = pace of change; Both needs evidence of both.
experience_frame: National statistics versus household/local circumstances. Do not infer from outlet location.
time_frame: Realized/current conditions versus forecasts and anticipated developments.
political_attribution: Explicit causal attribution of an economic outcome to political actors/institutions or policy; criticism/mention alone is Neither.
attribution_voice: Whose attribution is expressed. If attribution is Neither or Not applicable, voice must be Not applicable and target empty.
checkable_official_claim: Numerical assertion about an official economic/survey measure; prediction or private rate quote is not automatically an official claim. This is detection, NOT verification.

BINARY_RULES.topic_prices: Substantive inflation, price levels or consumer costs
BINARY_RULES.topic_employment: Substantive hiring, layoffs, unemployment, hours or labor markets
BINARY_RULES.topic_income: Substantive wages, income or purchasing power
BINARY_RULES.topic_growth: Substantive GDP, expansion, slowdown, recession or output productivity
BINARY_RULES.topic_housing: Substantive rents, home costs, affordability or supply
BINARY_RULES.topic_debt_finances: Substantive debt, borrowing, savings, rates or financial strain/security
BINARY_RULES.topic_spending_sentiment: Substantive spending, confidence or economic expectations
BINARY_RULES.rising_prices: Rising prices/increasing costs substantively discussed, not merely word inflation
BINARY_RULES.falling_inflation: Slowing inflation/disinflation substantively discussed, not automatically falling prices
BINARY_RULES.growth_expansion: Economic expansion/real output growth substantively discussed
BINARY_RULES.recession_risk: Recession, contraction or recession risk substantively discussed
